cells.name: gyro_rlg_schedule_reference
cells.lb: for SATs of GYRO RLG SIGMA 40

cells.value: as per IHQ MoD (N) / DSR approved schedule. Following observed:-

Test 1: verify from time to time that the INS SOG velocity is close to the Log speed. The difference must be lower than 3.5 Kts.
Achieved
Test 2: verify that the attitude data are credible to total 10 readings of Heading, Roll & Pitch of both RLG taken at every 05 Min. Mean error between both RLG are as follows:-
GPS Continuous Update test (TEST 3): GPS position enabled 12 readings of INU position and GPS position (Lt, Long) taken. Position error follows (Limit should be CEP1 less than 0.1 NM)
Test with INS + LOG (TEST 4): GPS position enabled for 01 Min then disable it for 01 Hour. Circular error probability (CEP2) ≤ 0.5 NM. Value Achieved

Free Internal Mode (NO LOG + NO GPS) (TEST 5): Enabled GPS position update and the Log during at least 05 Min, then disable it. One hour later, note the INU position devition with regard to the GPs position, CEP3 should be ≤ 0.8 NM
Transit Bearing checks were carried out while leaving harbour. Following value achieved:
Verify INU Sea alignment capability, to each SIGMA 40. Verified attitude and heading data are credible.
Interface checks with other user AIS, ECDIS, RADAR, CMS, WSDS etc.
